ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in recent Minnesota fraud cases, including the $46 million crypto theft and allegations of ignoring billions in scams
questions: How did the money move in these cases?
Are there any connections to other cases of fraud or corruption?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions in these cases, we may be able to identify patterns or connections that can help us better understand the scope of the problem and identify potential suspects or accomplices
